# The browsers Playwright 1.63.0 installs for the browser checks, each checked
# file for file by .github/scripts/verify-installs.py on every run: the SHA256
# of the browser's manifest ("sha256  path" for every file, sorted by path),
# worked out from the zip Playwright downloads:
#   chromium-1243                 cdn.playwright.dev/builds/cft/153.0.8010.12/linux64/chrome-linux64.zip
#   chromium_headless_shell-1243  cdn.playwright.dev/builds/cft/153.0.8010.12/linux64/chrome-headless-shell-linux64.zip
#   ffmpeg-1011                   cdn.playwright.dev/dbazure/download/playwright/builds/ffmpeg/1011/ffmpeg-linux.zip
# A new Playwright version changes these; the job refuses until they are
# worked out again from its zips and committed here.
